cohort: 2,701 patients undergoing operative procedures at 2 hospitals in rural Uganda
finding: In this prospective study of 2,701 patients in rural Uganda, the volume of surgery was low relative to the catchment population, and the perioperative mortality rate was high, particularly after exploratory laparotomy and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as a high-risk procedure with a perioperative mortality rate of 1%.
